en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central statue of a man in a long coat standing on a tall pedestal in a landscaped square or park. On the left is an ornate multi‑storey civic building with arched windows; in the background to the right stands a church or bell tower partly hidden by trees. Flowerbeds and paths surround the monument. Along the bottom border of the image, printed text identifies the place as the statue of Dr. Ioan Rațiu in Turda.
